plan.failureSummary: The chatbot application's backend endpoint (/api/chat) returns a 500 Internal Server Error upon message submission, preventing the chatbot from responding to any user prompts.
observedIndicators: Browser network log captured 500 Internal Server Error on POST requests to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat.
Chatbot message quota decremented but no response messages were rendered on the screen.
Autonomous agent correctly determined that evaluating chatbot compliance was not completable due to missing bot responses.

remediationSteps.details: Investigate and resolve the backend 500 Internal Server Error occurring at https://briefcase.chat/api/chat when processing user messages.

plan.notes: Autonomous execution attempted multiple prompts and checked settings/threads, but all chat requests to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat failed with HTTP 500. This server error prevents the chatbot from generating responses, causing the compliance evaluation objective to fail.
